author: Matthias F

title: Where Art Comes to Life
text:
I took the Exclusive Art and Galleries Tour with Katharyn—an artist herself—and discovered galleries I never knew existed, even after living in Barcelona. She was knowledgeable and engaging, encouraging  to find a piece that resonated with me before offering her insights. 

A highlight was visiting Bien Cuadrado studio, where I saw artists at work—an intimate, behind-the-scenes experience.

I also appreciated the thoughtful follow-up letter, which included a curated map of their favorite cafés, bars, and shops.

 A must-do for art lovers!

title: An unforgettable and precious day in Barcelona
text: It was an incredible experience! Learning about the history of Barcelona's architecture and street art was truly fascinating. Meeting local artists and witnessing their passion and love for art made the tour even more special. I’m thrilled to have yet another reason to return to Barcelona. Thank you so much for such a wonderful and inspiring time!

title: Great experience for families
text: A very enjoyable experience! The art walk was fun even for our little one. We visited a picturesque art district, art galleries, learned about street art, public art, and even history of the city. We appreciate the thoughtfulness and art savvy of our host, Katrina. 100% recommended!!
